visualCharacteristics.purpose: Grid of article teasers: image, linked title and short description
visualCharacteristics.description: Light grey (white-smoke) band with padding. Centered H2, two-line intro paragraph and underlined "Sign up" link; 4-column article cards (image top, bold underlined blue title link, grey description); centered "See all our stories" link below.

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one row per article: cell 1 = image, cell 2 = title link + description paragraph

usage: Place in a section styled `light-grey, centered`; section heading, intro and "See all" link stay as default content around the block. 1/2/4-column responsive grid.
reuseGuidance: Use for news/story teaser grids. For icon quick links use `cards-icon-links`.
